scenarios.title: Search state bills

scenarios.userInput:
Use the unchanged local Cicada Guide skills in .agents/skills. Read get-legislation/SKILL.md and the relevant task skill before answering. Use only the configured guide-public MCP tools for legislative facts. Do not use web search, shell HTTP requests, or outside knowledge as substitutes.
